post.description:
Register a new farm with validated GeoJSON polygon boundary.
- Calculates geodesic area in metric hectares and acres using WGS84 ellipsoid.
- Computes polygon centroid coordinates.
- Persists to PostgreSQL/PostGIS and memory cache.
- Enforces user ownership.

get.description:
List all farms belonging to the authenticated user.
Strictly isolated: users cannot see other users' farms.
Uses authoritative database persistence with bounded cache mirror.

schema.title: Response List Farms Api V1 Farms Get

get.description:
Retrieve farm by ID. Enforces strict user ownership check.
Uses authoritative database persistence with bounded cache mirror.

put.description:
Update farm details and/or farm boundary polygon.
- If boundary geometry is updated, recalculates geodesic area and centroid.
- Enforces ownership authorization.

delete.description: Delete a farm by ID. Enforces ownership authorization.

post.description:
Trigger or retrieve farm-specific soil intelligence extraction.
- Uses cached profile if force_refresh=False.
- If no cache or force_refresh=True, extracts raster properties from SoilGrids WCS.
- Derives USDA Soil Texture Classification (e.g. Clay, Clay Loam).
- Checks spatial representativeness for parcels < 6.25 ha.
- Strictly preserves unverified available NPK as null.
- Persists profile snapshot and parameters to PostgreSQL database.

post.description:
Execute deterministic agricultural evaluation of candidate crops for a farm context.
Evaluates hard constraints, Bahar water tables, and regional suitability with
evidence gating and explicit abstention triggers.
Dispatched via worker threadpool to prevent blocking the asyncio event loop.
Fuses confirmed laboratory soil measurements when available for the farm.

get.description:
Retrieve a previously computed farm evaluation decision by its decision ID.
Enforces caller and farm ownership.
Persisted across server restarts and accessible across multiple backend workers.

post.description:
Submit diagnostic follow-up answers to re-evaluate a farm context with updated parameters.
Enforces decision ownership before allowing re-evaluation.

Generate a natural, farmer-friendly explanation of a validated decision in English or Marathi.
The response is grounded in the deterministic decision payload and validated by numerical guardrails.
Enforces caller ownership of the underlying decision.

Interactive dialogue and follow-up consultation grounded in a validated agricultural decision.
If diagnostic answers are submitted, the deterministic engine re-evaluates the farm context first.
Enforces caller ownership of the underlying decision.
